pages.text: The Akaishi Equipment Forger recasts Netherite gear into Akaishi gear; the gear can no longer be crafted at a table, and this is the only production method.$(br2)$(bold)Ingot cost:$(reset)$(li)helmet 5, chestplate 8, leggings 7, boots 4$(li)sword 2, pickaxe 3, shovel 1, axe 3$(br2)One machine covers the whole set: insert the matching Netherite piece and select the result.

$(bold)Energy:$(reset) 50M Akaishi Energy plus 10M per assigned upgrade point.$(br2)The result starts with 4 upgrade points:$(li)+0.15 attack speed per point$(li)+1 attack damage per point$(li)+2 max health per point$(li)+1 armor per point$(li)+1 toughness per point$(li)pickaxes, shovels and axes can also take +20 efficiency per point$(br2)At most 4 points per recast; assignments can be undone and reassigned before confirming.

The recasting fuel, $(l:akaishi:ingot)Akaishi Ingots$(/l), is condensed by the $(l:akaishi:aggregator)Energy Aggregator$(/l); this machine consumes large amounts of energy, so $(l:akaishi:portable_cell)Portable Cell$(/l)-scale storage is recommended. Final stats are listed in $(l:akaishi:equipment)Equipment$(/l).
